split_rule: Per month, use days with at least 48 available data16_label frame files; choose a 2-consecutive-day validation block and a separate 2-consecutive-day test block whose starts differ by at least 6 days; reserve one calendar day before and after each block as buffer; select using Python random.Random(int(sha256('42:YYYY-MM')[:16],16)).choice over ordered candidate pairs.
selection_inputs: Only daily file counts and date/path metadata; no station GHI values, cloud/weather values, CPP/COT values, or model errors.
support_note: Timestamp-only 15-minute interval test (strictly target-15min < sample_time <= target_time, requiring 15 distinct minute bins) gives Wangzhai 36/37, Mizhuang 0/27, and Niushou 40/39 targets on Apr 29/30; May 15/16 gives Wangzhai 45/44, Mizhuang 45/45, and Niushou 44/42. April 20/21 validation gives Wangzhai 42/41, Mizhuang 40/44, and Niushou 43/45; May 3/4 gives Wangzhai 41/46, Mizhuang 41/41, and Niushou 43/45. Do not redraw blocks; report per-station support and use identical keys within each station-method comparison.
next_gate: Validate timestamp/unit/duplicate/missing-window and value quality using train/val labels only; test remains metadata-only until final evaluation lock.
